title: 清明上河图（虹桥段）
description: 虹桥横跨河面，船只与人群在桥下桥上交织。沿着暖褐色的屋宇和岸线看去，街市的细节一点点展开。
alt: 暖褐色像素画中，拱桥跨过河流，桥上人群与两岸屋宇密布。
englishTitle: Along the River During the Qingming Festival · Rainbow Bridge
englishDescription: An arching bridge spans the river as boats and crowds fill the scene above and below. Follow the warm brown rooftops and riverbanks to discover the small details of a busy town.
englishAlt: A pixel interpretation in warm browns, with an arched bridge, river boats, crowds and densely grouped buildings.

title: 千里江山图
description: 青绿山峰层层相叠，浅色水面从山脚缓缓穿过。把目光留在远近之间，岸边的屋舍与小舟便浮现出来。
alt: 青绿山峰在金褐色底上层叠，河流、屋舍与小舟散布其间的像素山水。
englishTitle: A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains
englishDescription: Blue-green peaks rise in layers, with pale water winding around their feet. Let your gaze travel between near and far to find small houses and boats along the shore.
englishAlt: A pixel landscape of layered blue-green mountains, pale waterways, small houses and boats against a golden brown ground.

title: 蒙娜丽莎
description: 交叠的双手与微微扬起的嘴角，让画面安静下来。人物身后的山水渐渐隐入灰绿色，衬出面庞温暖的光。
alt: 深色衣着的女子双手交叠，带着浅浅微笑，身后是灰绿色山水的像素肖像。
englishDescription: Folded hands and a barely lifted smile give the portrait its quiet presence. A distant landscape fades into gray-green tones behind the warm light on her face.
englishAlt: A pixel portrait of a darkly dressed woman with folded hands and a slight smile, set before a gray-green landscape.

title: 戴珍珠耳环的少女
collection: 海牙莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆
description: 少女侧身回望，蓝色头巾从深色背景里亮起。耳畔的一点珍珠光，与面颊和嘴唇上的微光轻轻呼应。
alt: 深色背景中，一位戴蓝黄色头巾的少女回望，耳边珍珠闪着亮光的像素肖像。
englishDescription: A girl turns to look back, her blue headscarf emerging from the dark background. A small gleam at her ear echoes the soft highlights on her cheek and lips.
englishAlt: A pixel portrait of a girl looking back against a dark background, wearing a blue and yellow headscarf and a bright pearl earring.

title: 星月夜
description: 蓝色夜空卷起层层旋涡，星与月在其中闪出金黄。低处的村庄安静沉睡，深色树影向天空伸展。
alt: 蓝色旋涡夜空中散布金黄星月，下方是村庄与高耸深色树影的像素风景。
englishCollection: The Museum of Modern Art, New York
englishDescription: Swirls sweep through a blue night sky, carrying the golden light of stars and moon. Below, a quiet village rests beside a dark tree reaching upward.
englishAlt: A pixel landscape with a swirling blue sky, golden stars and moon, a small village and a tall dark tree.

title: 神奈川冲浪里
description: 巨浪卷成弧线，白色浪尖像指爪般向下伸展。小舟贴着起伏的海面前行，远处的山峰静静立在浪间。
alt: 蓝色巨浪与白色浪花压向细长小舟，远处露出山峰的像素海景。
englishDescription: A great wave curls overhead, its white tips reaching down like fingers. Slender boats follow the swell while a distant mountain stands still between the waves.
englishAlt: A pixel seascape of a curling blue wave with white foam above slender boats and a distant mountain.

title: 洛神赋图
description: 飘带随衣袖舒展，人物的身影与水岸、山石相互映衬。沿着疏密相间的线条望去，一段相遇仿佛停留在金褐色的长卷里。
alt: 金褐色像素画中，衣带飘扬的女子悬在水岸上方，左侧人物坐在山石旁，水面散布花叶。
englishDescription: Flowing ribbons connect the figures with water, rocks and distant hills. Fine lines and open spaces hold a quiet encounter within a golden brown landscape.
englishAlt: A golden brown pixel scene with a ribbon-draped woman above the water, a seated figure beside rocks, and flowers along the shore.

title: 步辇图
description: 深色衣袍的坐像与左侧站立的人物遥相对望，侍从和仪仗在身后展开。朱红、赭黄与青绿的衣色，让疏朗的画面有了鲜明的节奏。
alt: 暖黄色底的像素人物画中，左侧三人站立，右侧一位深衣人物坐在步辇上，周围围着侍从和仪仗。
englishDescription: A seated figure in dark robes faces a small standing group, with attendants and ceremonial objects behind him. Red, ochre and green garments bring rhythm to the open ground.
englishAlt: A pixel scene on a warm yellow ground, with three standing figures facing a dark-robed figure on a litter surrounded by attendants.

title: 捣练图
description: 几位女子围着展开的白色绢帛，各自俯身、扶持或站立。衣裙的红绿纹样与细长的绢面相衬，让日常劳作显得从容而细腻。
alt: 赭黄色底的像素画中，几位身着红绿衣裙的女子围着一段白色绢帛劳作，旁边放着篮筐与器具。
englishTitle: Court Ladies Preparing Newly Woven Silk
englishDescription: Women gather around a length of pale silk, each bending, holding or standing at work. Patterned red and green robes frame the cloth with a calm, measured rhythm.
englishAlt: A pixel scene of women in red and green robes working around a length of white silk, with baskets and tools on an ochre ground.

title: 溪山行旅图
description: 高山从薄雾中直立而起，细长的瀑布划过深色岩壁。近处树石层叠，远处山势沉稳，细小的行旅身影让山水显得格外辽阔。
alt: 竖幅水墨像素山水中，巨大的深色山峰高耸，瀑布垂落，前景树木和山路旁可见细小行旅。
englishDescription: A mountain rises through mist, with a slender waterfall tracing its dark face. Layered trees and rocks fill the foreground, while tiny travelers reveal the scale of the landscape.
englishAlt: A vertical ink-style pixel landscape with a towering dark mountain, a waterfall, foreground trees and tiny travelers along a mountain path.

title: 富春山居图（剩山卷）
description: 淡墨山峦沿着开阔水面向远处推移，岸边树木与坡石疏密有致。大片浅色留白，让目光在山与水之间缓缓游走。
alt: 浅米色底的像素水墨山水中，远山层叠，近岸树丛与小丘围绕着开阔的水面。
englishTitle: Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains · The Remaining Mountain
englishDescription: Pale mountains recede beyond open water, with trees and rocky slopes gathered along the shore. Broad areas of light ground let the eye wander slowly between land and water.
englishAlt: An ink-style pixel landscape on a pale beige ground, with layered distant mountains, waterside trees and low hills around an open expanse of water.

title: 芙蓉锦鸡图
description: 锦鸡停在斜出的花枝上，长长的尾羽向下垂落。浅粉花朵、青绿叶片与上方的蝴蝶，把纤细的枝条衬得生动而轻盈。
alt: 浅色底的竖幅像素花鸟画中，彩色锦鸡立在开着粉花的枝头，长尾下垂，两只蝴蝶在上方飞舞。
englishDescription: A colorful pheasant rests on a flowering branch, its long tail falling below. Pink blossoms, green leaves and butterflies above give the slender branch a lively sense of balance.
englishAlt: A vertical pixel bird-and-flower painting with a colorful pheasant on a branch of pink blossoms, a long hanging tail and two butterflies above.

title: 墨葡萄图
description: 浓淡不同的墨色聚成叶片与葡萄，细细的藤蔓向空白处垂落。饱满的果串和松散的枝叶相互穿插，留下自由舒展的笔意。
alt: 米色底的竖幅像素水墨画中，深浅墨叶与成串葡萄聚在上方，细长藤蔓向下伸展，右侧有题字。
englishDescription: Leaves and grapes gather in shifting shades of ink, while thin tendrils trail into open space. Dense clusters and loose branches give the composition a freely unfolding rhythm.
englishAlt: A vertical ink-style pixel painting on beige paper, with dark leaves and grape clusters above, trailing vines below and an inscription at the right.

title: 群虾图
description: 几只虾斜斜穿过留白，透明似的躯体与浓墨点出的头部形成对比。长须与细足相互交错，像把水中的轻微流动也带进了画面。
alt: 浅米色底的像素水墨画中，数只灰黑色的虾斜向游动，长须与细足交错，左下有水草，右下有红印。
englishDescription: Shrimps drift diagonally through open space, their translucent-looking bodies contrasting with dark heads. Long antennae and fine legs overlap like traces of movement in water.
englishAlt: An ink-style pixel painting of gray-black shrimps swimming diagonally across pale paper, with long antennae, aquatic plants and a red seal.

title: 奔马图
description: 奔马迎面跃出，浓黑鬃毛与长尾向后飞扬。粗重的躯干和轻快的腿部线条形成对照，让静止的画面充满向前的力量。
alt: 浅色底的像素水墨画中，一匹黑灰色奔马跃向前方，鬃毛和长尾飞扬，左侧有竖排题字与红印。
englishDescription: A horse surges forward, its dark mane and long tail streaming behind. The weight of its body contrasts with swift lines in the legs, giving the still image a strong sense of motion.
englishAlt: An ink-style pixel painting of a black and gray horse galloping forward with a flying mane and tail, beside an inscription and red seals.

title: 维纳斯的诞生
description: 维纳斯立在贝壳上，长发随海风散开。浅蓝海面、飘落的花朵与岸边迎接的人物，让画面带着柔和而明亮的气息。
alt: 像素画中，一位长发女子立在海上的贝壳中，左上有人物吹风，右侧人物持衣相迎，周围散落花朵。
englishDescription: Venus stands on a shell as her long hair moves in the sea breeze. Pale blue water, scattered flowers and a welcoming figure on the shore give the scene a soft, luminous atmosphere.
englishAlt: A pixel scene of a long-haired woman standing in a shell on the sea, with wind-blowing figures above the left and a figure holding a robe at the right.

title: 最后的晚餐
description: 长桌前后的人物以不同姿态交谈，中央的身影保持安静。天花板与两侧墙面的线条向深处汇拢，把目光带向桌后的亮窗。
alt: 像素画中，一群人物围坐在铺白布的长桌旁，中央人物穿红蓝衣袍，房间的透视线延伸到后方亮窗。
englishDescription: Figures gesture and turn around a long table, while the central figure remains still. Lines in the ceiling and side walls lead the eye toward the bright windows behind them.
englishAlt: A pixel scene of figures gathered around a long white-covered table, with a central figure in red and blue and perspective lines leading to bright rear windows.

title: 雅典学院
description: 层层拱门之下，人物聚拢、交谈，也有人独坐沉思。明亮石阶和几何地面把空间向深处延伸，中央两人的身影落在拱门之间。
alt: 像素画中，众多穿长袍的人物聚集在高大的拱门大厅里，有人交谈，有人坐在台阶上，中央远处露出蓝天。
englishDescription: Beneath a sequence of arches, figures gather in conversation or sit alone in thought. Pale steps and a patterned floor draw the space inward toward two central figures.
englishAlt: A pixel scene of robed figures gathering and talking in a grand arched hall, with seated figures on steps and blue sky visible in the distance.

title: 创造亚当（西斯廷天顶局部）
description: 两只伸出的手停在将触未触的一瞬，成为画面的中心。舒展的人体、浅色天空与翻卷的衣褶相互呼应，把视线引向指尖间的留白。
alt: 像素壁画局部中，斜倚的男子向另一组被红色衣褶围绕的人物伸手，两人的指尖几乎相触。
englishTitle: The Creation of Adam · Sistine Ceiling Detail
englishDescription: Two outstretched hands pause just before they touch. Reclining forms, pale sky and billowing drapery guide the eye toward the small gap between the fingertips.
englishAlt: A pixel interpretation of a mural detail with a reclining man reaching toward figures enclosed in red drapery, their fingertips almost touching.

title: 夜巡
collection: 阿姆斯特丹国立博物馆
description: 人物从深色背景里走出，明亮的衣袖、面庞与金色细节依次浮现。旗帜和长杆交错其间，让密集的人群带着正在行进的动势。
alt: 暗褐色像素群像中，一队人物聚在一起，前方两人和左侧浅衣人物被光照亮，旗帜与长杆伸向上方。
englishDescription: Figures emerge from a dark background as sleeves, faces and golden details catch the light. A flag and raised poles weave through the group, suggesting a gathering about to move.
englishAlt: A dark brown pixel group portrait with two figures in front and a pale-clad figure at the left caught in light, beneath a flag and raised poles.

title: 宫娥
description: 浅色裙装的女孩站在房间中央，身旁的人物或俯身，或转头凝望。暗处的画框、后方的门口与前景的狗，把室内空间一层层展开。
alt: 像素室内群像中，一位穿浅色宽裙的女孩站在中央，周围有侍从，前景有狗，后墙挂着画框并开着亮门。
englishDescription: A girl in a pale dress stands at the center as nearby figures bend toward her or turn to look. Framed pictures, a distant doorway and a dog in front build layers of depth within the room.
englishAlt: A pixel interior with a girl in a wide pale dress surrounded by attendants, a dog in front, framed pictures and a bright doorway at the back.

title: 自由引导人民
description: 高举的三色旗从烟尘中展开，中央人物向前迈步。周围人群、倒下的身影与远处建筑叠在一起，让画面显得紧张而有力。
alt: 像素画中，一名女子举起蓝白红三色旗越过瓦砾向前，持械人群跟随，前景有人倒卧，远处城市笼罩在烟雾中。
englishDescription: A raised tricolor opens above the smoke as the central figure strides forward. The crowd, fallen bodies and distant buildings gather into a scene of tension and force.
englishAlt: A pixel scene of a woman raising a blue, white and red flag as she crosses rubble, followed by armed figures, with fallen bodies and a smoky city beyond.

title: 雾海上的旅人
artist: 卡斯帕·大卫·弗里德里希
description: 一位旅人背对观者，独自立在近处的岩石上。雾气漫过层层山谷，只留下零散峰顶，让深色身影与辽阔远景形成安静的对照。
alt: 竖幅像素风景中，一名持手杖的男子背对观者站在岩石上，前方是雾气覆盖的山谷与层层远山。
englishTitle: Wanderer Above the Sea of Fog
englishDescription: A traveler stands alone on a rocky ledge with his back to the viewer. Mist fills the valleys and leaves scattered peaks visible, setting the dark figure against a wide, quiet distance.
englishAlt: A vertical pixel landscape with a man holding a walking stick on a rocky ledge, seen from behind above mist-filled valleys and distant mountains.

title: 日出·印象
description: 橙红色的太阳悬在蓝紫色雾气中，倒影在水面拉出一串暖光。近处小舟沉静，远处桅杆与烟影交织，港口像刚从清晨醒来。
alt: 蓝紫色像素港湾中，橙红太阳和倒影照亮水面，前景有深色小舟，远处排列着船只、桅杆与烟雾。
englishDescription: An orange-red sun hangs in blue-violet mist, leaving a warm trail across the water. A small boat rests in the foreground while masts and smoke blur into the waking harbor.
englishAlt: A blue-violet pixel harbor with an orange-red sun and its reflection, a dark boat in front, and distant ships, masts and smoke.

title: 向日葵
description: 金黄花朵从花瓶里向四周舒展，有的盛开，有的低垂。深褐花心与青绿背景相互映衬，让一束花也有了丰富的姿态与节奏。
alt: 竖幅像素静物中，黄色花瓶放在金黄桌面上，向日葵向四周展开，深色花心与浅青绿背景形成对比。
englishDescription: Golden flowers spread outward from a vase, some open and others bending low. Dark centers stand against a pale green-blue background, giving the bouquet varied shapes and rhythms.
englishAlt: A vertical pixel still life of sunflowers with dark centers in a yellow vase on a golden table, set against a pale green-blue background.

title: 大碗岛的星期天下午
description: 人们散落在树荫与草地之间，有的坐着，有的撑伞眺望水面。鲜明的色块连成树叶、衣裙与河岸，把一个午后的闲适凝在画中。
alt: 像素风景中，人们在绿树与草地间坐卧或撑伞站立，左侧水面有帆船，明亮草坪与深色树荫交错。
englishTitle: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte
englishDescription: People rest in the shade or stand with parasols beside the water. Bright blocks of color gather into leaves, clothes and riverbank, holding the ease of an unhurried afternoon.
englishAlt: A pixel riverside scene with people sitting or standing with parasols among green trees, sailboats on the water, and bright grass crossed by deep shade.

title: 睡莲
description: 粉色睡莲散在蓝绿色的水面，圆叶之间映出摇曳的枝条与光。视线随着细碎色块游移，水面仿佛一直在轻轻变化。
alt: 蓝绿与紫色交织的像素池塘中，粉色睡莲和绿色圆叶浮在水面，垂下的枝条与天空倒影穿插其间。
englishDescription: Pink water lilies scatter across blue-green water, with reflections of hanging branches and light between the leaves. Small shifts of color make the surface seem gently restless.
englishAlt: A pixel pond in blue, green and violet, with pink water lilies, round green leaves, hanging branches and reflections of the sky.

title: 吻
description: 相拥的两人被金色衣袍包围，方块与圆形纹样在衣面交错。脚下花草细密，面庞与双手从装饰中显露，留下温柔而亲近的一瞬。
alt: 金色像素画中，一对人物相拥亲吻，衣袍布满方形与圆形纹样，脚下是繁密花草，周围有金色装饰边框。
englishMedium: Oil and gold leaf on canvas
englishDescription: Two embracing figures are enclosed in golden robes patterned with rectangles and circles. Flowers gather at their feet while faces and hands emerge from the decoration in a tender, intimate moment.
englishAlt: A golden pixel painting of two figures embracing and kissing in robes patterned with rectangles and circles, above flowers within an ornamental border.

title: 美国哥特式
description: 两个人物并肩站在木屋前，笔直的草叉与身后的尖顶窗相互呼应。深色外衣、朴素衣领和严肃神情，让画面显得安静而端正。
alt: 竖幅像素双人肖像中，一名女子与戴眼镜、手持草叉的男子并肩站立，身后是一栋有尖顶窗的白色木屋。
englishDescription: Two figures stand side by side before a wooden house, the upright pitchfork echoing the pointed window behind them. Dark clothes, plain collars and solemn faces give the scene a still, formal presence.
englishAlt: A vertical pixel portrait of a woman beside a bespectacled man holding a pitchfork, standing before a white wooden house with a pointed window.
